"""Finite BRIDGE TEST; exact source coefficient intervals, no cofinal claim."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from flint import arb, arb_mat, ctx, fmpq, fmpq_poly
from q3_exact_autocorrelation import build_rplus
from q3_schur_polynomial_interval import full_q_enclosure, public_data

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = Path('/mnt/hdd01/Soft/GitHub/chen_q3_rh_clean/docs/routeB_bus/phase5_codex/six_centre/out/radical_shell_stability_20260909.json')

def main():
    ctx.prec = 512
    raw = SOURCE.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '9721df7209b020fb0abf7b47e0f71590abd4ddb3d0163fa91c7506de8385bcbf'
    data = json.loads(raw)
    hashes = {'container': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    expected_engines = {
        'q3_schur_polynomial_interval.py': data['exact_frozen_polynomial_followup']['script_sha256'],
        'q3_exact_autocorrelation.py': data['full_source_margin_followup']['artifacts']['q3_exact_autocorrelation.py']['sha256'],
    }
    for name, expected in expected_engines.items():
        actual = hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert actual == expected, (name, actual, expected)
        hashes[name] = actual
    def get(section, name):
        item = data[section]['artifacts'][name]
        payload = item['utf8_content'].encode()
        assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
        hashes[name] = item['sha256']
        return json.loads(payload)
    ref = get('positive_reference_followup', 'q3_reference_tail.json')['evaluations'][-1]
    moments = get('full_source_margin_followup', 'q3_source_moments_interval.json')['evaluations'][-1]
    env = get('full_source_margin_followup', 'q3_source_complex_envelope.json')['evaluations'][-1]
    theta = data['theta_norm_and_source_profile_followup']['true_theta_norm']['result']
    names = ['Phi'] + [f'g{2*j}' for j in range(7)]
    assert ref['members'] == names
    H = arb_mat(8, 8)
    for i in range(8):
        for j in range(i, 8):
            v = arb(ref['H_entries'][names[i]+'|'+names[j]]['H_entry']['ball'])
            H[i,j] = v
            H[j,i] = v
    ell = arb_mat([[arb(v['ball'])] for v in ref['ell']])
    w = H.solve(ell, algorithm='lu')
    Z = sum((ell[i,0]*w[i,0] for i in range(8)), arb(0))
    assert Z > 0
    th = [w[i,0]/Z for i in range(8)]
    assert all(th[i].overlaps(arb(ref['theta_H'][i]['ball'])) for i in range(8))
    assert sum((ell[i,0]*th[i] for i in range(8)), arb(0)).contains(1)
    N = arb(moments['N_a']['ball'])
    assert N > 0
    coeff = [v/N for v in th]
    a = arb(7)/10
    aq = fmpq(7,10)
    z = fmpq_poly([0,1])
    deriv = [fmpq_poly([0,-3,2])]
    for _ in range(14):
        p = deriv[-1]
        deriv.append((fmpq(1,2)-2*z)*p+2*z*p.derivative())
    basis = [deriv[0]]+[deriv[2*j+2]-deriv[2*j]/4 for j in range(7)]
    majors = [arb(env['polynomial_majorants']['Phi_upper']['ball'])]
    majors += [arb(v['upper']['ball']) for v in env['polynomial_majorants']['directions']]
    M = sum((c.abs_upper()*v for c,v in zip(coeff,majors)),arb(0)).abs_upper()
    tails = moments['profile_tail_envelopes']
    B = [arb(tails['Phi']['B']['ball'])]+[arb(v['B']['ball']) for v in tails['directions']]
    series_error = sum((c.abs_upper()*v.abs_upper() for c,v in zip(coeff,B)),arb(0)).abs_upper()
    def evaluate(x):
        values = [arb(0) for _ in basis]
        for n in range(1,9):
            zn = arb.pi()*n*n*(2*x).exp()
            factor = (x/2-zn).exp()
            for i,p in enumerate(basis):
                v = arb(0)
                for c in reversed(p.coeffs()):
                    v = v*zn+arb(c)
                values[i] += factor*v
        v = sum((c*u for c,u in zip(coeff,values)),arb(0))
        return v+arb(0,series_error)
    degree = 192
    print('START_SYNTHESIS', flush=True)
    nodes = [evaluate(arb(0) if j == degree//2 else a*arb.cos_pi_fmpq(fmpq(j,degree))) for j in range(degree//2+1)]
    nodes += list(reversed(nodes[:-1]))
    beta, eta = [], []
    for k in range(degree+1):
        v = nodes[0]/2+(-1)**k*nodes[-1]/2
        for j in range(1,degree):
            v += nodes[j]*arb.cos_pi_fmpq(fmpq(k*j,degree))
        v *= arb(2)/degree
        if k in (0,degree):
            v /= 2
        exact = v.mid().fmpq()
        beta.append(exact)
        eta.append((v-arb(exact)).abs_upper())
    u = 4*M/arb(2)**degree+sum(eta,arb(0))
    b = 4*M*(degree**2+4*degree+6)/(a*arb(2)**degree)+sum((k*k*v/a for k,v in enumerate(eta)),arb(0))
    cu = arb(env['E_transfer_coefficients']['C_u']['ball'])
    cb = arb(env['E_transfer_coefficients']['C_b']['ball'])
    error = (cu*u*u+cb*b*b).sqrt().abs_upper()
    x = fmpq_poly([0,1/aq])
    prev,cur = fmpq_poly([1]),x
    poly = beta[0]*prev+beta[1]*cur
    for k in range(2,degree+1):
        prev,cur = cur,2*x*cur-prev
        poly += beta[k]*cur
    synthesis = {'source_hashes':hashes,'theta_lu':[str(v) for v in th], 'Z':str(Z), 'normalized_coefficients':[str(v) for v in coeff], 'M':str(M), 'E_error':str(error), 'power_coefficients':[str(v) for v in poly.coeffs()], 'u_total':str(u),'b_total':str(b)}
    payload = (json.dumps(synthesis,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
    (ROOT/'bridge_synthesis.json').write_bytes(payload)
    poly_hash = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    print('START_EXACT_GEOMETRY', str(error), flush=True)
    norm,r,h = build_rplus(poly,aq)
    print('START_FULL_Q', flush=True)
    result = full_q_enclosure(poly,norm,r,h,4096,384)
    q = result['_q_ball']
    d = result['_dirichlet_ball']
    pnorm = ((2*a).exp()*arb(norm)+d).sqrt().abs_upper()
    transfer = (22*error*(2*pnorm+error)).abs_upper()
    source_q = q+arb(0,transfer)
    eps = arb(theta['evaluations'][-1]['T_squared']['ball'])
    margin = arb(fmpq(107,100))*eps-source_q
    sign = 'UNRESOLVED'
    if margin.lower()>10*margin.rad().abs_upper():
        sign = 'ELSE_A'
    elif -margin.upper()>10*margin.rad().abs_upper():
        sign = 'ELSE_B'
    out = {'status':'PROVISIONAL_PENDING_REVIEW','finite_branch':sign,'source_hashes':hashes,'synthesis_sha256':poly_hash,'engine_sha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'q3_schur_polynomial_interval.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'E_error':str(error),'transfer':str(transfer),'source_Q':str(source_q),'T_squared':str(eps),'Q_over_T_squared':str(source_q/eps),'margin':str(margin),'total_radius':str(margin.rad()),'polynomial':public_data(result),'RH_claim':False}
    (ROOT/'bridge_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('BRIDGE_TEST_DONE',sign,str(margin),flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
